unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U26: Organise proactive disclosure,records and accessible request handling

payload.title: Reduce the need for repeated individual requests
payload.core_explanation_md:
The public authority record system must support access through cataloguing, indexing and the described appropriate computerisation. Proactive disclosure covers organisation, functions, decision processes, rules, official responsibilities, budgets and access arrangements, with the required updates. It is not satisfied by publishing an empty RTI contact page once. Information should be communicated in accessible, effective forms with attention to local language and cost.

The PIO gives the described reasonable assistance where a person cannot make the request in writing. If another authority holds the information or the subject is more closely connected with its functions, the transfer route uses the stated five-day limit and applicant notification. Assistance and transfer differ from refusing a request simply because it reached the wrong desk.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a single contact page fulfil all proactive-disclosure duties?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The prescribed substantive information and updates matter.

payload.stem_md: A public authority publishes only its PIO name and no organisational or decision-process disclosures. Which duty remains?

options.text_md: The substantive proactive-disclosure and update requirements
options.explanation_md: Contact information is only part of the framework.

options.text_md: None, because any website is sufficient
options.explanation_md: Website existence alone is not compliance.

options.text_md: The applicant must create the authority manuals
options.explanation_md: The authority has the record/disclosure duties.

options.text_md: All records must be destroyed after website publication

payload.correct_explanation_md: Contact information is only part of the framework.

payload.stem_md: The requested records are held by another public authority. What does the described transfer route require?

options.explanation_md: The source requires action and notice.

options.text_md: Demand a reason for the applicant interest as a universal condition
options.explanation_md: That is not the stated transfer requirement.

options.text_md: Transfer within the stated five days and inform the applicant
options.explanation_md: The custodian and communication must be handled.
That exceeds the request and ignores safeguards.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The custodian and communication must be handled.
